Lost B2B wholesale deals take ~4x longer to close than won ones (35.5 vs 9.1 days avg) — time-open is our clearest warning sign.
Deal size doesn't predict win/loss: win rates stay flat at 79-88% across all deal-size bands, from under €3,000 to over €12,000.
Performance is broadly consistent across our 5 B2B wholesale merchants (75-88% win rate), but one rep at Polder Packaging wins only 57% — a likely coaching opportunity, not a systemic issue.
